descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A4 · P2 · 无障碍

多处文字对比度不达 AA（问卷按钮 3.66:1，Previous Notes 标题 2.5:1，dashboard 房号行等）

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-06/S24a, TC-13/S22, TC-25/S21

思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S18 「两个 dashboard 都过 axe，计数放在 live region 里」 Both dashboards pass axe, and the counts sit in a live region

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B)（TFA-92598 AC 2；TFA-92598 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3；TFA-92598 How it works 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Standard fixture; visual lane screen hospital-dashboard (exists) and nh-dashboard (to add)

When Visual lane runs axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA on both dashboards, plus a DOM check on the element that holds the four tiles

Then No serious or critical violations. The tiles have readable label/number pairs, each patient row is a button named with the patient's name, and the tile container has aria-live (polite) or role=status, so a count change is announced (WCAG 4.1.3)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical. A separate DOM check, because axe does not flag a missing live region: the element containing the Total/Pending/In Progress/Complete tiles has aria-live='polite' (or role='status'), and the tile numbers are inside it (main has aria-live='polite' on the dl). …

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92598 in progress

两个 dashboard 上，房号 / 待办数那一行和状态标签的对比度不够（不达 WCAG AA），不容易看清。

On both dashboards the room / pending-task line and the status pill are too low in contrast to read easily (they fail WCAG AA).

依据：allure-results/9b6f2679…: visual lane, 12 pass / 6 fail on desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. axe: the room / '1 task pending' line (#90a1b9) and the status pill fail AA contrast on both dashboards. The live region and patient-named row buttons pass.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S18

Both dashboards pass axe, and the counts sit in a live region

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (in progress)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：lists.spec.ts: both dashboards; axe serious/critical; live region around the four tiles with the numbers inside; row buttons named with the patient. — Whether VoiceOver/TalkBack actually announces a change is S20b (a person with a screen reader).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 12 judged check(s) passed, 6 failed. The tiles sit in a live region (aria-live=polite on the dl) with the numbers inside; each row is a button named with the patient.

产品问题：Contrast: the '1 task pending' / room line (#90a1b9) and the status pill fail AA on both dashboards (oracle: zero serious/critical).

证据：附了 5 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-20_S18 — 目录（15 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
